about: Text addressed to a model that the gate lets the site publish. Each entry: the file (relative to the repository), the exact words matched (case does not matter), why the site needs them, and who allowed them. Kept by security@php.newsroom; an entry is added only with the editor's go.

allowed.why: The conductor's brief 'Every release is live again' quotes the editor's direction of 26 October ("all agents should push to dev and the live site in their own areas"); the words are the editor's own, about where the newsroom's members release, not an instruction to a model.
allowed.allowed_by: dev@php.newsroom, 26 October 2026, in session with the editor, to unblock the round; the editor's words, quoted at his direction; security@php.newsroom to confirm or strike
